# My plan
{: .no_toc }

Free or Standard: what covers you, your own subscription, upgrade and manage billing.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `BIL-01` |
| **Route** | `/billing` · deep link `substratal://billing` |
| **Where** | Personal › Plan & Billing |
| **Who can use it** | Self; billing.manage can view any User's (read-only) |

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Plan card | card | UserSubscription.plan free\ | standard | .card box |
| Covered by | list | plan_sources[]: {type user\ | organization, id} | GtkListBox .boxed-list |
| Double coverage tip | banner | plan_sources has both user and organization | "Your organization already covers you. You can cancel your own subscription in Manage billing." (no automatic refund) | AdwBanner |
| Your subscription | key-value | Subscription.status, current_period_end, cancel_at_period_end, unit_amount, currency | status badge via status-semantics; past_due → warning banner (Stripe retries ~3 weeks) | AdwActionRow subtitle |
| Upgrade to Standard | primary-button | → BIL-03 checkout | when no covering subscription, or own subscription is incomplete/incomplete_expired/canceled/unpaid; price "$6 per month" from unit_amount when known, else from pricing config; store flags on iOS/Android | GtkButton .suggested-action .pill |
| Manage billing | button | → BIL-03 portal | when the user has completed a checkout (own subscription exists and isn't incomplete) | GtkButton |
| What Standard includes | link | standard apps from GET /applications?access_tier=standard | count + list | GtkButton .flat / GtkLinkButton |

## Good to know

- **Loading, empty and error states:** Loading: skeleton after 300 ms; Error: inline with Retry; codes per COPY-AND-STATES; After return from checkout: poll GET /users/me/subscription every 2 s (max 30 s) until plan = standard, showing "Finishing up…"; Downgraded: "Your Standard access ended on {date}. Your data is kept."
- Business/Enterprise aren't offered (422 plan_requires_sales); show "Contact sales" link only. Annual plans and a Standard trial are undecided in the API (DECISIONS #31) — no UI for them.

## For developers

Loads: `GET /users/me/subscription`

Every call sends `Substratal-Version: 1` to `https://api.substratalapps.com` (no `/v1` in the path). See [API versioning]({{ '/api/versioning/' | relative_url }}) and the [API reference]({{ '/api/reference/' | relative_url }}).
